meta.name: modlens
meta.description: Plug-in vision for text-only models. Hard rule: when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .heic, .heif) appears anywhere in the conversation (typed by the user, injected as a `[Image: source: <path>]` line, or inside a tag) and you cannot see that image's content, run this skill on it before any other approach: no self-built OCR, no PIL, no tesseract. Also triggers on pasted-image placeholders such as `[Image #1]` and `[Unsupported Image]`. If you can actually see the image, do not use this skill. When unsure, run `modlens guard` before the first read of a session: a deny verdict means the active model has native vision and must read the image itself. Runs the modlens CLI to convert the image into structured JSON evidence: every word transcribed, layout regions, semantics, visual clues. Also use when the user asks how to install, configure, or switch modlens providers (Gemini API key, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Claude API or Claude Code CLI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 转写图片为结构化文本,供纯文本模型理解
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的模型读不了图片,却要处理截图或照片
copy.tagline_en: Turn images into structured text so text-only models can understand them
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your model lacks vision but still needs to process images

howto.what: 当对话里出现图片而模型看不到内容时，Claude 会调用 modlens（不自建 OCR/PIL）把图片转成 JSON 证据（文字转写、布局、语义、视觉线索）并据此作答，拿不准会明说；也处理 modlens 的安装配置问题。
howto.when: 当对话里出现图片文件路径/URL（.png、.jpg 等）、[Image #1] 这类粘贴占位符，或用户询问 modlens 的安装/配置时触发；且仅当模型看不到图片内容时启用。

say.text: 读一下 /tmp/photo.png 这张图，里面写了什么？
say.note: 会调用 modlens 转成 JSON 证据再回答。

say.text: 帮我给 modlens 配好 Gemini API 密钥。
跑一下 modlens doctor，看当前环境能不能用。
say.note: 检查可运行运行时、提供商与守卫裁决。

howto.what_en: When an image appears but the model cannot see it, Claude runs modlens to convert it into structured JSON evidence (words, layout, semantics, clues) and answers from that, flagging uncertainty. Also handles install/config questions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a path/URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, etc.) or a placeholder like [Image #1] appears, or when the user asks about modlens install/config—only if the model can't see the image.

say_en.text: Read the text in /tmp/photo.png for me.
say_en.note: Runs modlens and answers from the JSON evidence.

say_en.text: Set up the Gemini API key for modlens.
Run modlens doctor to check this environment.
say_en.note: Shows runtimes, providers, and guard verdict.
